description_template: ECS task killed due to OOM during deployment
proven_fix: Increase ECS task definition memory from 512MB to 1024MB. Update service to use new task definition revision. Monitor with Container Insights.

description_template: Glue job failed with JDBC connection timeout
proven_fix: Increase JDBC connection timeout to 120s. Add retry logic with exponential backoff. Consider dedicated Redshift WLM queue for ETL workloads.

description_template: EBS volume disk full due to log accumulation
proven_fix: 1. Clean old logs: find /var/log -mtime +7 -delete. 2. Extend EBS volume. 3. Add logrotate config. 4. Set CloudWatch alarm at 80%.

description_template: Service unreachable through ALB due to missing security group rule
proven_fix: Add inbound rule to service security group allowing traffic from ALB security group on the application port. Verify health check path and port match.

description_template: Upstream schema change broke ETL pipeline
proven_fix: Enable schema evolution in Glue job using ResolveChoice. Add schema change detection alert. Implement upstream schema contract validation.

description_template: Lambda function missing S3 write permissions
proven_fix: Add inline policy to Lambda execution role with s3:PutObject scoped to specific bucket/prefix. Include KMS encryption condition if bucket is encrypted.

description_template: Terraform apply failing with state lock timeout
proven_fix: Force-unlock stale state lock: terraform force-unlock <lock-id>. Add pipeline step to detect and alert on stale locks older than 30 minutes.
Check extract/refresh schedule timing vs ETL completion time. Adjust extract schedule to run after ETL SLA. Verify source table has fresh data.
